title: System Design Using AI: I Just Talk and Claude Draws It
description: There is one habit that makes talking to Claude painfully slow when you build a system design diagram, and I only caught it halfway through this one.
I dictate a simple web server architecture into a local Excalidraw with Wispr Flow, from the client and load balancer to two web services and a database, without dragging a single shape.
chapter_stamps: Give It All Your Thoughts at Once
Why I Use Wispr Flow for Everything
